Before you reach out

A little detail.
A better start.

Help us understand what you need, while keeping your private information safe.

What should I include?+

Give a short description of your question and the page or step you were using. For a technical issue, include your device and browser. If you share a screenshot, hide any private details first.

What should I keep private?+

Never share passwords, one-time codes, full bank details, or identity documents through social messages. Keep other people’s personal information out of public comments.

What if a conversation makes me uncomfortable?+

You can stop an interaction at any time. Keep a record of concerning messages and avoid sending money or more personal information. If you are in immediate danger, contact local emergency services. Favorite Hearts support is not an emergency service.

Where can I learn more about Favorite Hearts?+

Discover the values behind Favorite Hearts on our Mission page, explore relationship ideas at Favorite Labs, or find our latest updates in the Newsroom.
